_note: T-268 Mixamo pack manifest. file = stem of build/graphics/staging/mixamo/<who>/<file>.fbx; name = clip name in the packed library; loop = loop the clip; window = [start, end] seconds of the source to keep (optional); hips_xz = 'keep' (default), 'rest' (pin to the rest value) or 'loop' (remove the net travel so the end meets the start); fix_loop = blend the end pose back onto the start pose so a cut window loops without a pop.
